newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish department stores DT Centrum sale seen Q2.
newsitem.headline: Polish department stores DT Centrum sale seen Q2.

text.p: The privatisation of Poland's largest department store chain Domy Towarowe Centrum SA (DTC) is likely to be concluded in the second quarter of 1997, a treasury ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
"Currently there are final negotiations on the social package and they are close to their end...the sale of DTC could take place in the second quarter of the year," Maciej Chojnacki told Reuters.
In 1995 Poland invited bids for 75 percent of DTC, with 20 percent of shares earmarked for employees and five for restitution claims.
DTC has 31 departments stores in Poland.
